decisions.reason: The approval authority and quota-counting rule are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The confirmed quota and approval rule do not change the Lead Clipper responsibilities or convert the future advancement pathway into an immediate assignment.
The official monthly offer follows qualification but does not change the qualification method, required trial clip, deadline, or success condition.
The monthly quota decision does not alter the task-local channel or content used to submit sample clips for guideline review.
Publishing only approved clips to the dedicated Instagram account is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.
Defining which clips count toward the monthly quota does not modify the substantive requirement that each clip contain a complete standalone teaching moment.
The confirmed monthly quota and approval authority do not change permitted source content or the trial batch source constraint.
The approval-counting rule does not alter the existing clean and simple editing standards.
The source decision does not change the required caption color, font, or effects.
The monthly approved-clip quota does not change the required 30-to-90-second clip duration.
The approval and quota-counting terms do not modify the standard for selecting strong, impactful source moments.
